paras: The plain honeyeater (Pinarostola ixoides) is a species of bird in the family Meliphagidae. It was formerly placed in the genus Pycnopygius.
It is found in Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.
Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.
